desc: Ideate and select the cycle-reachability + SCS/LIS reduction.

Implement and validate the complete Python solution: parse input; build invP/invQ; traverse from X via invP/invQ until returning to X to get orderP/orderQ and distance arrays; if any A_i=1 has distP=-1 or any B_i=1 has distQ=-1 print -1; set D_R/D_B to the maximum red/blue distances; build R=orderP[D_R:0:-1] and B=orderQ[D_B:0:-1]; compute LCS length using a position list for B and strict LIS with bisect_left over positions from R; print len(R)+len(B)-LCS; run the four samples plus edge cases to confirm outputs 4, 0, -1, 8.
